description: This file defines a GStreamer metadata structure and associated functions for handling protection metadata related to Rialto's EME (Encrypted Media Extensions) protection. It includes macro definitions, a struct declaration, and function prototypes for managing protection metadata within GStreamer buffers.

classes.name: GstRialtoProtectionMetadata
classes.description: A GStreamer metadata structure that contains protection info for Rialto's EME implementation.

methods.name: rialto_eme_protection_metadata_get_type
methods.description: Returns the GType for the protection metadata, used for GObject type system.

methods.name: rialto_mse_protection_metadata_get_info
methods.description: Returns metadata information about the protection metadata type.

methods.name: rialto_mse_add_protection_metadata
methods.description: Adds protection metadata to a GStreamer buffer with the specified info structure.
